description: This file is a Java interface definition for PatientService, which declares methods related to patient management in the OpenMRS system, including CRUD operations, mergers, death processing, allergies, and identifier validation.

classes.name: PatientService
classes.description: Interface defining methods for patient management, including CRUD operations, identifier handling, allergies, merging, death processing, and validation within the OpenMRS system.

methods.name: setPatientDAO
methods.description: Sets the Data Access Object (DAO) for this service, typically injected via dependency injection.

methods.name: savePatient
methods.description: Creates or updates a patient record in the database. Includes validation, setting defaults, and conflict resolution.

methods.name: getPatient
methods.description: Retrieves a patient by internal database ID.

methods.name: getPatientOrPromotePerson
methods.description: Retrieves a patient by ID, promoting a Person to a Patient if applicable.

methods.name: getPatientByUuid
methods.description: Fetches a patient by its UUID.

methods.name: getPatientIdentifierByUuid
methods.description: Fetches a patient identifier by its UUID.

methods.name: getAllPatients
methods.description: Returns all active (non-voided) patients.

methods.name: getAllPatients (boolean)
methods.description: Returns all patients, including voided ones based on the parameter.

methods.name: getPatients
methods.description: Finds patients based on name, identifier, and types with various search options.

methods.name: voidPatient
methods.description: Voids a patient record, marking it as deleted without removing it from the database.

methods.name: unvoidPatient
methods.description: Reverses the voiding of a patient record.

methods.name: purgePatient
methods.description: Deletes a patient record entirely from the database, for testing or administrative purposes.

methods.name: getPatientIdentifiers
methods.description: Retrieves patient identifiers matching specific criteria such as identifier, types, locations, etc.

methods.name: savePatientIdentifierType
methods.description: Creates or updates a patient identifier type.

methods.name: getAllPatientIdentifierTypes
methods.description: Retrieves all non-retired patient identifier types, ordered by default comparator.

methods.name: getAllPatientIdentifierTypes (boolean)
methods.description: Retrieves all patient identifier types, optionally including retired ones.

methods.name: getPatientIdentifierTypes
methods.description: Fetches patient identifier types matching specific criteria like name, format, required, and check digit.

methods.name: getPatientIdentifierType
methods.description: Retrieves a patient identifier type by internal ID.

methods.name: getPatientIdentifierTypeByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a patient identifier type by UUID.

methods.name: getPatientIdentifierTypeByName
methods.description: Retrieves a patient identifier type by its exact name.

methods.name: retirePatientIdentifierType
methods.description: Retires a patient identifier type with a given reason.

methods.name: unretirePatientIdentifierType
methods.description: Unretires a patient identifier type.

methods.name: purgePatientIdentifierType
methods.description: Permanently deletes a patient identifier type from the database.

methods.name: checkPatientIdentifiers
methods.description: Validates all identifiers for a patient, throwing an exception if invalid conditions are found.

methods.name: getPatients (with search string)
methods.description: Searches for patients matching a query string.

methods.name: getPatients (with pagination)
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of patients matching a query string.

methods.name: getPatients (with advanced options)
methods.description: Retrieves patients with detailed filtering, including voicing and pagination.

methods.name: getPatientByExample
methods.description: Finds a patient in the database matching attributes of a given patient object.

methods.name: getDuplicatePatientsByAttributes
methods.description: Finds potential duplicate patients based on list of attribute names.

methods.name: mergePatients (with two patients)
methods.description: Merges two patient records into one, consolidating data and handling conflicts.

methods.name: mergePatients (with list of patients)
methods.description: Merges multiple patients into one main Patient record.

methods.name: processDeath
methods.description: Marks a patient as deceased at a specified date with cause of death concept.

methods.name: saveCauseOfDeathObs
methods.description: Records an observation indicating when and why the patient died.

methods.name: getIdentifierValidator
methods.description: Retrieves an identifier validator instance by class or class name.

methods.name: getDefaultIdentifierValidator
methods.description: Returns the default patient identifier validator.

methods.name: getAllIdentifierValidators
methods.description: Returns all registered identifier validators.

methods.name: isIdentifierInUseByAnotherPatient
methods.description: Checks if a given patient identifier is already used by another patient.

methods.name: getPatientIdentifier
methods.description: Retrieves a patient identifier by internal ID.

methods.name: voidPatientIdentifier
methods.description: Voids (soft deletes) a patient identifier with a reason.

methods.name: savePatientIdentifier
methods.description: Creates or updates a patient identifier.

methods.name: purgePatientIdentifier
methods.description: Permanently deletes a patient identifier from the database.

methods.name: getAllergies
methods.description: Fetches allergies for a given patient.

methods.name: setAllergies
methods.description: Updates the allergies for a patient, handling additions, voiding, and comments.

methods.name: getAllergy
methods.description: Fetches allergy detail by allergy list item ID.

methods.name: getAllergyByUuid
methods.description: Fetches an allergy by its UUID.

methods.name: saveAllergy
methods.description: Creates an allergy record.

methods.name: removeAllergy
methods.description: Marks an allergy as removed by setting stop date.

methods.name: voidAllergy
methods.description: Voids an allergy record, typically due to error.

methods.name: getCountOfPatients
methods.description: Returns the count of patients matching a search query.

methods.name: getCountOfPatients (with Voided parameter)
methods.description: Returns count including/excluding voided patients.
